{{Quote|Malgus...traitor.|Unidentified Sith warrior|<ref name="Disorder" />}}
A '''Sith warrior''' fought for the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Third Galactic War]]. At some point, the warrior went searching for a [[Darth Nul's holocron|holocron]] at the [[Temple of Nul]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Elom (planet)/Legends|Elom]] and encountered [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Denolm Orr]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Sa'har Kateen]] and engaged them in a duel. The warrior was defeated by the two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and was later [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the rogue [[Darth Malgus]] soon after, who was also searching for the same [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]].<ref name="Disorder" />
